UK VAT Scheme Comparison (2026/2027)

VAT Scheme TypeTurnover LimitVAT Accounting MethodKey Advantage
Standard Rate VATNo limitCharge 20% VAT, reclaim 20% input VAT on expensesBest if expenses are high with heavy input VAT
Flat Rate Scheme (FRS)Up to £150,000/yrCharge 20% VAT, pay lower flat % to HMRC on gross revenueSimplified bookkeeping & keep flat rate margin

Frequently Asked Questions (UK VAT)

The mandatory UK VAT registration threshold is £90,000 of taxable turnover over a rolling 12-month period. If your turnover exceeds £90,000 in any 12-month period (or is expected to exceed £90,000 in the next 30 days), you MUST register with HMRC.
